purpose: Bind deterministic material-state transition tile resolutions to the generated strict-32 world environment atlas for runtime preview drawing.

runtimeBehavior.fallback: If no binding exists for a cell, draw the older prototype TileKind terrain renderer.

authoritativeStatePolicy: Render bindings are derived client-side preview state. Host/server authority remains material state and paint deltas, not raw pixels.
drawPolicy: Only strict 32x32 atlas rects selected by the transition tile resolver are drawn through this binding.
